raw_text: Use context within and beyond a sentence to determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases. (I)
competency_statement: Use the context around a word or phrase, both inside and outside a sentence, to figure out or clarify its meaning, especially for words that are unknown or have multiple meanings.
observable_behaviors: Look at the words and sentences before and after an unknown or multiple-meaning word to understand its meaning.
Use clues from the surrounding text to decide what a word or phrase means in that context.
Explain how the context helps determine the meaning of a word or phrase.
skill_clauses: Use context within a sentence to determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases.
Use context beyond a sentence to determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases.

student_actions.recognition_identification: Identify unknown or multiple-meaning words and phrases in text.
student_actions.procedural_application: Use context clues within and beyond a sentence to determine or clarify word meanings.
student_actions.reasoning_explanation: Explain how context helps determine or clarify the meaning of unknown or multiple-meaning words and phrases.
